prices.setupNotes: The current public Web Connect 40/20 Mbps product lists R439 per month and installation/setup included. WiFi is built into the installed ONT rather than supplied as a separate router. The first month must be paid before the order is processed. Openserve may apply fair-use speed restrictions; confirm exact address availability and final fees.

Its Vumatel section also discloses a R999 termination fee on cancellation or cancellation for non-payment. Confirm the address-specific quote and current terms.

Frogfoot Air 25/10 Mbps is area-specific and advertised at R549 per month. WiFi is built into the ONT; setup is included. The page specifies month-to-month service, one calendar month cancellation notice, a R249 processing fee and a R999 termination fee on cancellation or cancellation for non-payment. This product is advertised without a fair-use threshold; confirm address-specific terms.
